issue_context.title: SWC doesn't enforce (TS1155): 'const' declarations must be initialized.
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

The given input code, `swc` compiles, and produces this output:
```
"use strict";
const why;
```
`tsc`, on the other hand, produces this error: 
error TS1155: 'const' declarations must be initialized.


### Input code

```typescript
const why;
```


### Config

```json
{
  "jsc": {
    "parser": {
      "syntax": "typescript",
      "decorators": true,
      "tsx": false
    },
    "transform": {
      "legacyDecorator": true,
      "decoratorMetadata": true
    },
    "target": "es2022",
    "loose": false,
    "externalHelpers": false,
    "keepClassNames": true
  },
  "module": {
    "type": "commonjs",
    "strict": true,
    "strictMode": true,
    "lazy": false,
    "noInterop": false
  },
  "isModule": true,
  "minify": false
}
```


### Playground link

https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.2.144&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0vOzysuUSjPqLTmAgCplY8ZCwAAAA%3D%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0WPvW7DMAyE30Wzh8Kj13ZoB%2FcdCPkcKJFEgWSAuEHevRJsORv%2F7rvj013Vu%2BnpColCWqVbNnq4ydlWoF5CMTe4BZ6FjEXdZHLH4Ezr0UpR8aqNUNaVJTVCxIX89tUVXXAiZhgtZLQvmprkAquW0PFjHKtdZFYc%2BMHhYZBM8RuxoCU45jegfEZS%2FaUEPXGJl3tES9JeqFjPKXG%2BagWrSfDWI%2B3dzAv6JNLfdvIz%2F%2BTqzOX9aND5oO%2F3KeSwdsXrH6k%2FedRPAQAA

### Expected behavior

Expected this code not to compile, with an output similar to: `error TS1155: 'const' declarations must be initialized.`


### Actual behavior

The code compiles without errors.

### Version

1.2.144

### Additional context

_No response_
